player_prompt.intro:
Nde Player {player_id} Chopsticks-pe. Nde ñe'ẽme, eiporavo:
  + Atake:  '[attack M O]'  M=nde jyva (0 térã 1), O=contrincante jyva (0 térã 1).
    - Contrincante jyva kuéra okakuaa nde jyváre; si ≥5, oiko 0.
  + Jejoka:   '[split L R]'  ejejoka nde kuéra ñande jyváre L ha R (L+R = nde total).
Ehendu ñande komando.

invalid_move.invalid_command: Movimiento iválido. Eipuru “[attack M O]” térã “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} oataka P{opp_id} jyva {opp_idx} pe: oiko {opp_val} guive {new_val} peve.
